# STM Journals

> > STM Journals is a peer-reviewed academic publishing platform operated by Consortium e-Learning Network Pvt. Ltd., featuring open-access and hybrid journals across materials science, genetics, medicine, engineering, and land management.

Based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, STM Journals publishes research indexed in Google Scholar with SJIF ratings. The platform uses CC BY-NC-ND licensing and covers interdisciplinary scientific research from crystalline materials to deep learning applications in medical imaging.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed academic publishing
- Open-access and hybrid open-access journals
- Materials science and crystalline materials
- Genetic modifications and recombinations
- Deep learning in medical imaging
- Medical image encryption
- Land management and sustainable development
- Surgical research
- CNN-based classification
- CC BY-NC-ND licensing
- SJIF indexing
- Google Scholar indexing
- High-performance machining
- Programmed cell death research
- Data augmentation techniques

## Core Journals

- [International Journal of Crystalline Materials](https://journals.stmjournals.com/ijcm): Peer-reviewed journal on crystalline materials science by STM Journals
- [International Journal of Genetic Modifications and Recombinations](https://journals.stmjournals.com/ijgmr): Open-access genetics journal covering genetic modifications by STM Journals
- [International Journal of Land](https://journals.stmjournals.com/ijl): Open-access journal on land management and sustainable development
- [Research and Reviews: Journal of Surgery](https://journals.stmjournals.com/rrjos): Hybrid open-access peer-reviewed surgery journal by STM Journals

## Medical and Biomedical Research

- [Pneumonia Detection and Classification Using Deep Learning](https://journals.stmjournals.com/jomet/article=2024/view=177490): Research article on pneumonia detection using deep learning in JoMET
- [Understanding Programmed Cell Death](https://journals.stmjournals.com/article/article=2024/view=177394): Article on programmed cell death types: apoptosis, autophagy, pyroptosis
- [Deep Learning Algorithms for Medical Image Encryption](https://journals.stmjournals.com/joipprp/article=2024/view=177854): Research on deep learning for medical image encryption in JoIPPRP
- [Comparative Analysis of Data Augmentation Techniques in CNN-Based Classification of Atelectasis](https://journals.stmjournals.com/jomet/article=2024/view=177480): CNN-based atelectasis classification using data augmentation in JoMET

## Engineering and Manufacturing Research

- [Experimental Study on the Wear Mechanisms of Cutting Tools in High-Performance Machining](https://journals.stmjournals.com/ijfmds/ijfmds-ijfmds/article=2024/view=177734): Study on cutting tool wear in high-performance machining in IJFMDS
